name: discord
description: Drive Discord servers, channels, members, and messages through a 95-tool MCP server backed by discord.js — send, read, edit, and pin messages; manage channels, threads, roles, and permissions; moderate members; automate webhooks, forums, and scheduled events.

interface.shortDescription: Send, read, and manage Discord messages, channels, members, and roles from any MCP-compatible agent.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can help you manage your Discord server — sending messages, moderating channels, managing roles, setting up webhooks, organizing forums, and scheduling events. Whether you run a community server or just want your agent to send announcements and moderate discussions, everything happens through natural language. No more switching back to Discord for every routine task.
defaultPrompt: Send an announcement to the general channel on my server.
Show me recent messages and activity in my Discord server.
Help me set up a new channel with the right permissions.
